title: New Zealand election too close to call as Luxon's coalition holds a slim lead
caption:
New Zealand's general election ended without a clear winner. On preliminary results, Prime Minister Christopher Luxon's coalition of National, ACT and NZ First would hold 67 of 130 seats, just above the 66 needed for a majority. Special votes are still being counted, and the final result is due on November 27.

One story. Twice a day. Follow for the next edition.
